purpose: Picks a value, or a range between two ends, by position on a track where the place in the range matters more than the exact number. Optional tooltips show the value and tick marks show the scale.

notFor.case: The exact number matters or will be typed.
Collecting a 1–5 score or a sentiment.
Showing progress or a measured value the person cannot change.

Default.visual: Track Surface/muted; range Action/primary/default (default) or Content/primary (secondary); marks Border/strong with Content/secondary labels; tooltip Surface/inverse with Content/inverse text.

Dragging.visual: The range keeps its Default fill; the dragged thumb takes SliderThumb Dragging.

Disabled.visual: Range Action/disabled/default, mark labels Content/disabled; thumbs take SliderThumb Disabled.

a11y.role: slider (one per thumb, with aria-valuenow / min / max)
a11y.keyboard: Each thumb is one tab stop. Arrow Right / Up increases by one step, Arrow Left / Down decreases; Page Up / Page Down and Shift+Arrow move a larger step; Home / End go to the minimum / maximum (Radix Slider).
notes: Give the slider an aria-label; show the value (tooltip) when it matters.

openQuestions: Motion: the State axis (Default · Dragging · Disabled) has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry. Should the range fill or the tooltip move with a role? (finding MOT-002 Slider)
Figma paints the mark tick Border/strong at 50 % opacity; no role covers that opacity. Is a role missing?
Range: does each of the two thumbs need its own accessible name (start / end), and who supplies it?
